statements: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS `velox_dev`.`mfg`

steps.title: Copy packdwh_src.mfg.BillOfMaterial to velox_dev.mfg.billofmaterial
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `velox_dev`.`mfg`.`billofmaterial` AS SELECT
  `BomLineKey`,
  `ProductKey`,
  `MaterialKey`,
  `QuantityPerThousand`,
  `UnitOfMeasure`,
  `ScrapAllowancePct`,

steps.title: Declare the primary key of BillOfMaterial (BomLineKey)
statements: ALTER TABLE `velox_dev`.`mfg`.`billofmaterial` ADD CONSTRAINT `BillOfMaterial_pk` PRIMARY KEY (`BomLineKey`)

risks.text: OccurredAt (datetimeoffset) becomes a TIMESTAMP in UTC: the point in time is kept, its offset is not.
ReportedAt (datetimeoffset) becomes a TIMESTAMP in UTC: the point in time is kept, its offset is not.
PackagingProduct has no primary key: duplicate rows cannot be detected.
StartedAt (datetimeoffset) becomes a TIMESTAMP in UTC: the point in time is kept, its offset is not.
ReportedAt is converted to UTC while StartedAt and CompletedAt are datetime2 without an offset, so comparing them may be skewed by the original time zone.
The links to machine, line, plant and product are plain integer columns that the copy does not enforce, so orphan rows can appear unnoticed later.
In the source data already, “Warranty does not end before the machine was installed” does not hold: a finding about the data, not a test of the migration.
In the source data already, “A product is not discontinued before it was launched” does not hold: a finding about the data, not a test of the migration.
BillOfMaterial has no primary key in the source: the model chose (BomLineKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
BillOfMaterial's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
EnergyReading has no primary key in the source: the model chose (ReadingKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
EnergyReading's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
Machine has no primary key in the source: the model chose (MachineKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
Machine's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
ShiftStart (time) becomes a TIMESTAMP: Databricks has no time-of-day type, so each value gets a date.
MachineEvent has no primary key in the source: the model chose (EventKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
MachineEvent's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
MaintenanceWorkOrder has no primary key in the source: the model chose (WorkOrderKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
MaintenanceWorkOrder's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
Material has no primary key in the source: the model chose (MaterialKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
Material's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
PackagingProduct's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
Plant has no primary key in the source: the model chose (PlantKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
Plant's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
ProductionLine has no primary key in the source: the model chose (LineKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
ProductionLine's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
ShiftStart (time) becomes a TIMESTAMP: Databricks has no time-of-day type, so each value gets a date.
ProductionRun has no primary key in the source: the model chose (ProductionRunKey), unique and never null in the source; the unique-key test checks the copy.
ProductionRun's text columns compare without case in Synapse (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS) and with case in Databricks: a filter, join or key on them may match other rows after the migration.
ReadAt, ReadingDateKey and ReadingHour describe the same moment in three columns and nothing in the copy keeps them consistent.
Oee, Availability, Performance and QualityRate are floating-point values whose scale (fraction or percent) is not documented, so downstream reports may misread them.
LabourCostEur and PartsCostEur are SQL Server money values, and their exact decimal precision in Databricks should be confirmed before finance reports use them.

summary: This plan copies the 10 manufacturing tables from packdwh_src.mfg into velox_dev.mfg as Delta tables with the same names in lower case, and lets velox-users read them. The rule-based tests check row counts, columns, NOT NULL, sums and date ranges against the source. The added tests check business rules: dates and quantities in the right order, hours within a day, and machines, lines, plants, materials and products that exist in their parent tables. Before approving, look at the timestamp risks: some columns lose their time zone offset, and some are compared with columns that never had one.
